name: Child's room
description: Three-year-old's room in a rental. Lower walls painted cream with a scalloped edge, upper walls white with felt decorations and a name decal. Toddler bed in the corner under a fabric canopy hung from a ceiling hook. Low open shelf under the window. Small play table and chair. A wall-mounted shelf and plug-in sconce sit above the table with the cord running down the wall.
